source_snapshot.procedure: Master issues read-only OEM `ipmitool raw 0x30 0x22` and checks all fan control mode and speed.
source_snapshot.criteria: Validate completion code; decode 1h Manual and 0h Auto; decode PWM duty 00h..64h as 0..100 percent.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES substitutes `raw 0x30 0x30 0x01 0x02` and greps sensor text. It supplies no model/firmware-bound command authority, byte layout, completion-code handling, fan topology, unit/freshness rules or secret-safe execution.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly requires an authoritative protected read command/parser, completion/mode/duty decoding, every mapped fan and strict no-write behavior.

old_problem: Although the stated operation is read-only, raw OEM bytes are not portable and nearby write commands are dangerously similar. The repository does not contain an approved response schema proving byte order, length, completion semantics, 0h/1h meanings or 00h..64h duty scaling for the intended BMC firmware. DeepSeek's different query cannot be adopted as authority.
disposition_reason: The Master purpose and criteria are coherent, so DeepSeek's alternate proposal is rejected rather than treated as an authoritative source conflict. However, ED-03 explicitly forbids guessing OEM parameters, and the missing byte-level query/response definition is the core operation and PASS evidence, not a mere IP or topology placeholder. The case remains Pending until the platform owner versions the read command and decoder for the exact BMC firmware; complete read-only execution can then proceed without any fan-control write.
decision_basis: XLSX row 978, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 979 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 979 / variant b2633d7f0c511699.

IPMI v2.0 provides transport, completion and manufacturer/product identity, but OEM command payloads and response bytes require a priori vendor knowledge. It cannot validate either raw command or the Master field encoding.

The Master supplies a coherent desired decode, but no repository authority states response length/offsets, whether duty is per-controller or per-zone, treatment of unavailable bytes, or whether 0x64 is a raw percentage on this firmware.

Fan RPM cannot establish control mode: an Auto loop can hold a steady duty, and Manual mode can temporarily match Auto RPM. The decoded authoritative state and separately complete fresh per-fan telemetry are both required.

ED-03, ED-14, ED-15, ED-17, ED-19, ED-21 and ED-30 require approved OEM semantics, full identities and no invented PASS; ED-34 through ED-38 require an approved read tool/schema, protected evidence, no write/clear/retry and engineer-owned acceptance.

test_case.test_name: Read and decode fan-control completion, mode and duty and reconcile every mapped fan without changing state
test_case.purpose: Using only the exact model/firmware-approved OEM read operation, verify the command completes successfully, decode current Auto/Manual mode and duty/zone data from the versioned response schema, enumerate every Project fan channel with fresh unit-aware speed/status, and reconcile the reported state with the current cooling context while proving no control state changed.
required_package: Vendor/platform-owner query specification tied to BMC manufacturer ID, product ID, model and firmware with exact netfn/cmd/request bytes and proof the operation is read-only

Versioned response schema defining response length, field offsets/order, completion-code handling, 0h/1h mode values, 00h..64h scaling, zone/controller cardinality, reserved/error values and endianness
Pinned reviewed Script/parser source and tests for valid, short, extra, unsupported and invalid responses without fallback to write-capable commands
Complete controller/zone-to-physical fan/rotor/SDR-sensor topology and expected current control context
Approved RPM/PWM units, status, zero/absent/disabled/stale distinctions, sensor freshness/tolerance and mode-duty-to-telemetry consistency rules
Secret-safe authenticated IPMI transport with bounded timeout, protected raw evidence, preserved SEL/audit logs and owner enablement approval
test_case.test_command: DO NOT EXECUTE while Pending. After the exact query/schema is approved: verify immutable BMC manufacturer/product/model/firmware and the pinned parser; capture pre-read mode-independent fan/temperature/health and SEL/audit evidence. Through secret-safe authenticated IPMI, issue exactly the approved read-only request once with a bounded timeout and preserve the raw request metadata, response bytes, transport status and completion result. Reject unexpected length/reserved values; decode mode, duty and any controller/zone fields only by the approved schema. Independently enumerate the complete approved SDR/sensor map—never grep a subset—and record each fan/rotor identity, RPM or declared unit, state/health and freshness. Compare decoded mode/duty/zone values with the approved current context and compatible telemetry without inferring mode from RPM. Repeat only if the approved evidence plan explicitly calls for a non-automatic second read and confirm no state changed. Do not clear logs, issue set-mode/set-duty/OEM fallback commands, expose credentials, inject faults, reset/reboot or power-cycle.
test_case.expected_result: The approved read query returns an accepted transport/completion result and a response of the exact supported shape. The schema deterministically decodes the expected current Auto or Manual value, duty within the approved 00h..64h domain and any zone/controller identity. Every mapped fan sensor is present as expected, fresh and internally consistent with the decoded state under the recorded context. Raw evidence is protected, logs contain no unexpected event, and pre/post evidence proves the control state did not change.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the model/firmware-approved read bytes and parser, accepted completion/response shape, unambiguous mode/duty/zone decoding, complete mapped fan enumeration, unit/freshness/state handling, context-consistency checks and no-write proof. A successful process exit, undecoded hex, DeepSeek's alternate query, grepped sensor lines, one RPM value or inference from speed cannot pass. Invalid completion/length/reserved value, ambiguous mode/duty, missing/stale fan, inconsistent telemetry or any state change is FAIL. Until command and response authority exists, this remains ENGINEERING DECISION PENDING rather than guessing a parser.
safety_gate: Never execute during review and never replace Master `0x30 0x22` with DeepSeek or adjacent set/restore bytes without exact vendor approval.
Require proof that the approved raw request is read-only for the matched manufacturer/product/firmware; byte similarity to a known query is insufficient.
Use secret-safe credentials and bounded timeout; preserve raw bytes securely and redact authentication data from shared evidence.
Decode only exact approved lengths/offsets/enums and distinguish zero duty from absent, disabled, stale, reserved or error values.
Preserve logs; prohibit set-mode/set-duty, fan manipulation, fault injection, reset/reboot and power transitions.
Stop on any command/schema/identity/telemetry ambiguity and do not try alternative raw bytes or automatically retry.
expected_evidence: Owner-approved model/firmware-bound read command and response schema plus pinned reviewed parser/tests
BMC manufacturer/product/model/firmware identity and secret-safe transport/no-write audit
Protected raw request metadata, response bytes, completion/transport result and deterministic field-by-field decode
Complete controller/zone/fan topology and timestamped per-fan identity, RPM/unit, state/health/freshness matrix
Decoded mode/duty/context consistency analysis and pre/post proof that control state/logs were unchanged
Engineer PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED verdict and explicit no-clear/no-fallback/no-retry evidence
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. On invalid completion, unexpected response length, unknown byte, missing/stale fan or inconsistency, stop and preserve/redact the raw and telemetry evidence for the BMC owner. Do not issue alternate raw bytes, set fan state, clear logs, reset/reboot, power-cycle or automatically retry.

source_conflict.reason: The Master defines one coherent read intent and response model. DeepSeek is review-layer advice, not source authority, so its differing raw form is rejected; the unresolved issue is missing OEM validation, not competing Master requirements.

blocked.reason: The read-only functional objective and safe contract are clear. Exact vendor query/schema authority remains an Engineering Decision Pending item rather than a separate permanent BLOCKED category.

pending.missing_evidence: Model/firmware-bound proof that Master or another exact request is read-only; byte-level response length/offset/enum/error schema; validated parser; zone/fan mapping and consistency rules.
pending.responsible_owner: Platform BMC/thermal owner with firmware vendor
pending.unblock_condition: Versioned approval of the exact read command and tested response decoder for the intended BMC firmware, including completion/mode/duty/zone semantics and no-write proof.
pending.execution_status: NOT EXECUTABLE; STATIC REVIEW ONLY; NO OEM QUERY, FAN CONTROL, SENSOR QUERY, LOG CLEAR, RESET, POWER OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1
external_authorities.application: Defines IPMI transport, completion framework and manufacturer/product identification for OEM interpretation; it does not define the fan query or response fields.

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide 2025.3
external_authorities.application: Defines standard Fan/Sensor/Status telemetry usable for independent correlation; it cannot supply the missing OEM raw response schema.

project_authority: Only the platform BMC/thermal owner and firmware-vendor specification can establish that the exact bytes are a read operation and define the response layout. Those core semantics are not safely parameterizable without approval.
